prereg.model: Skyrme model, massless pions (m = 0), Skyrme units: energy F_pi/(4e), length 2/(e F_pi) (ANW convention F_pi = 2 f_pi). Static density |d phi|^2 + 1/2[(tr D)^2 - tr D^2]; kinetic |v|^2(1+|d phi|^2) - sum (v.d_i phi)^2. Lattice: forward/backward symmetric differences, Dirichlet phi = (1,0,0,0) on the walls. Bogomolny bound 12 pi^2 |B|.

parameter_count.Lagrangian: 2 (F_pi, e); pion mass not used (would be a 3rd)
parameter_count.numerical_choices: h, box, dt, taper, sponge (convergence parameters, not physics)
parameter_count.K4_physical_numbers: only dimensionless e matters for dimensionless ratios; it is fixed from ONE measured ratio M_Delta/M_N (a 1-input fit). F_pi then from M_N (2nd input). Everything else declared below as prediction, fit, or identity.

K1.runs: B = 1 hedgehog, arrested Newton flow, dt = 0.15 h, stop when relative energy change over 100 iterations < 1e-9 or 2500 iterations; L^3 = 32^3, 48^3, 64^3 at h = 0.2 (half-box 3.2, 4.8, 6.4) and h = 0.15 (2.4, 3.6, 4.8); start = ODE profile; extra: crude start f = pi exp(-r/0.6) at h = 0.2, L = 48; informative: h = 0.25, L = 38.
K1.literature: E/12pi^2 = 1.2315 (massless; ANW M = 36.5 F_pi/e = 1.232 x 3 pi^2) - verified by our ODE (1.23148)

exams.K1a_continuum: h^2-Richardson from (h=0.2, L=48) and (h=0.15, L=64) (same half-box 4.8): |E/12pi^2 - 1.2315| < 1 %
exams.K1d_topology: |B - 1| < 0.01 for all production lattices and the crude start reaches the same E within 0.2 %

K2.runs: relaxed lattice profile (h = 0.2) boosted along x: phi(x) = phi_s(gamma (x - x0)), v_field = -v d_x phi; box 112 x 48 x 48, dt = 0.1 h, v = 0, 0.3, 0.6, 0.8, run time such that the knot travels >= 3 radii (t = 6, v = 0.3: t = 8); v = 0.8 repeated at h = 0.15 (box 150 x 64 x 64) if time allows; reference E0 = lattice energy of the unboosted same profile in the same box.

exams (each v = 0.3, 0.6, 0.8 at the fin.K2b_contraction: baryon density: (sigma_x / sigma_y) averaged over the second half of the run = 1/gamma within 3 % (rest run v = 0 sets the reference ratio, which must be 1 within 1 %)
exams (each v = 0.3, 0.6, 0.8 at the fin.K2c_shape_kept: energy density sigma_x at end / at t = 0 within 3 % (contracted shape is a travelling solution)
exams (each v = 0.3, 0.6, 0.8 at the fin.K2d_speed: centroid velocity (baryon density, linear fit over second half) within 3 % of v
exams (each v = 0.3, 0.6, 0.8 at the fin.K2e_min_balls: report the smallest contracted r_half / h for which K2a-d pass
exams (each v = 0.3, 0.6, 0.8 at the fin.energy_drift: < 0.5 % (else the run is declared numerically invalid)

K2.informative: energy-density sigma_x/sigma_y vs 1/gamma (T00 is not a Lorentz scalar: not expected to be exactly 1/gamma)

K3.runs: product ansatz U = U1 U2, h = 0.2, box 64^3 (half 6.4), sponge in the outer 1.4 (sigma <= 2), centres +-2 on x, dt = 0.1 h. B = 1 + B = -1 (antiSkyrmion = hedgehog with pi -> -pi): v = 0 (each at rest), 0.3, 0.6 head-on; t_max = 12. B = 1 + B = 1 in the attractive channel (2nd isorotated by pi about z), v = 0.5 each, t_max as fits.

exams.K3a_unknotting: S + antiS: integral |b| d^3x falls below 0.2 (from ~2) before t_max, for every speed
exams.K3b_radiation: S + antiS: [E_in(0) - E_in(t_max)] / E_in(0) >= 70 % with E_in = energy inside the sphere r < 4.5
exams.K3c_B2: S + S: B stays 2 within 2 %, and a 90-degree scattering (lumps leave along an axis perpendicular to x) or a bound toroidal B = 2 state (reported, literature: torus, 90-degree scattering)
exams.control: a single Skyrmion in the same lattice and time keeps B within 1 % (else annihilation could be a lattice artefact)

K4.inputs: Lambda from the relaxed lattice hedgehog (h = 0.2 and 0.15) by rigid isorotation, kinetic energy = Lambda w^2 / 2

exams.K4a_inertia: lattice Lambda (Richardson in h^2) within 2 % of the radial ODE value 103.90
exams.K4b_mu_ratio: |mu_p/mu_n| (e fixed from M_Delta/M_N = 1232/938.92: a 1-input fit) within 3 % of experiment 1.460; ANW obtained 1.43
exams.K4c_expected_failures: g_A within 30 % of 1.2754 and F_pi within 30 % of 184 MeV: literature (ANW 0.61, 129 MeV) says both FAIL
exams.spin_half: NOT computed: Finkelstein-Rubinstein (pi_1 of configuration space = Z2) is cited, not derived

K4.classification: 0-input: E/12pi^2, Lambda (Skyrme units), r_E/r_B, rotor ratio (M_{5/2}-M_{3/2})/(M_{3/2}-M_{1/2}) = 5/3, mu_NDelta = (mu_p-mu_n)/sqrt2 (identity of the collective quantization). 1-input (M_Delta/M_N): |mu_p/mu_n|, g_A, F_pi/M_N, M_N r. 2-input: F_pi, radii in fm, absolute moments.

K5.render: isosurface (marching tetrahedra) of the baryon density at 10 % of its maximum, relaxed B = 1, h = 0.2, L = 64

exams.K5b_fidelity: isosurface centroid within h of the true centre and principal-radius anisotropy < 5 %
